newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bank shares lose ground on Beirut bourse.
newsitem.headline: Bank shares lose ground on Beirut bourse.

text.p: Bank shares lost momentum and investors seemed to be leaning towards Solidere shares on the Beirut Stock Exchange on Monday, brokers said.
Solidere B shares were the only ones to rise on the BSE, climbing to $13.125 from $13 on Friday.
Solidere A shares were flat at $13.
"Bank shares took a breather today after rising," said a broker. "People may be taking profits from bank shares and leaning towards Solidere."
The LIBX bank index fell 1.8 percent to 196.23 and the LISPI dropped 0.41 percent to 96.94 while the BLOM general index climbed 0.22 percent to 1115.55.
Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce dropped to $21.50 from $21.75 while Bank of Beirut fell to $5.6875 from a record high of $5.9375. Banque Audi held steady at $28.
BSE turnover fell to 258,337 shares from 358,121 for a value of $2,996,644 against $3,326,895.
There was no trade in the other listed industrial firms -- Uniceramic, Ciments Blancs and Eternit .
